scope.purpose: Bounded release-timing supplement, not an edit of prior capability determinations

github_source.timestamp_limit: Git author/committer and GitHub signature-verification metadata; not independently established public-repository visibility or model-weight release time
github_source.receipt_time_meaning: Current session record timestamp after connector retrieval; not exact request time or historical public visibility

citation.quote: We're releasing two flavors of the open models:

repository_release_statement.interpretation: Official repository commit contains a releasing statement and links both variants; commit date does not prove precise public model release time

repository_card_pointer.interpretation: The initial committed README points to a mutable official landing URL; no linked PDF bytes or document edition are bound

model_release_date.reason: The dated official launch announcement could not be acquired (HTTP403). The Git commit date and document cover/submission dates are different evidence types and are not promoted to actual model release timing.

model_card_at_release.reason: No launch-time historical model-card/PDF bytes were acquired. Current landing fetch403 and bounded archival index fetch503 do not establish absence. arXiv's later submission does not rule out a prior provider-hosted edition.

stop.remaining_gap: Actual model release timing and model-card edition bytes publicly available at launch remain unverified.
